title: 04 5V BOOST POWER OUTPUT
purpose: TPS61023DRLR synchronous boost converter with true load disconnect. Boosts VSYS (battery power-path) to 5.0V for USB-C OTG 5V output power delivery and (rev B) as the 5 V PVDD supply of the mono MAX98357A Class-D amplifier during playback. Features 3.7A valley switch current, 1MHz switching frequency, and ultra-compact SOT-563 package. Controlled by MCU via VBUS_BOOST_EN signal.

parts.role: Synchronous Boost Converter with True Output Disconnect
100k pull-down on VBUS_BOOST_EN to ensure 5V boost is disabled by default
100k bottom feedback resistor R2 on FB divider
150k top feedback resistor R1 (Part A) on FB divider
10uF input ceramic decoupling capacitor on VIN
10uF secondary output ceramic capacitor for low transient ripple

qa.formula: V_OUT = V_REF * (1 + R1 / R2), V_REF = 0.600 V (TPS61023 Datasheet Section 9.2.2.1)
qa.result: R1 = 733 kOhm, R2 = 100 kOhm -> V_OUT = 0.600 * (1 + 7.33) = 5.00 V. Output matches standard 5.0V USB OTG requirement.
qa.source: Texas Instruments TPS61023 Datasheet SLVSEU1A Section 9.2.2.1

qa.formula: I_peak = I_OUT / (eta * (1 - D)) + (V_IN * D) / (2 * f_sw * L)
qa.result: With V_IN_min = 3.0V, V_OUT = 5.0V, I_OUT = 500mA, eta = 90%, f_sw = 1MHz, L = 0.47 uH: D = 0.40, I_peak = 1.39A. Selected XFL4015-471MEC (Isat = 4.4A) operates well below saturation limit.
qa.source: Texas Instruments TPS61023 Datasheet SLVSEU1A Section 9.2.2.2

qa.formula: EN = LOW -> VOUT disconnected from VIN via integrated isolation switch
qa.result: Integrated back-to-back isolation FET guarantees 0 mA leakage into VBUS_BOOST when disabled, preventing reverse discharge of LiPo into external devices when charging.
qa.source: Texas Instruments TPS61023 Datasheet SLVSEU1A Section 8.3.1

qa.item: Rev B: 5 V rail load with Class-D amplifier PVDD
qa.formula: I_OUT = P_spk / (eta_amp * V_PVDD) = 3.0 W / (0.85 * 5.0 V) = 0.71 A; I_peak = I_OUT/(eta*(1-D)) + V_IN*D/(2*f_sw*L)
qa.result: At V_IN_min = 3.0 V, D = 0.40: I_peak = 0.71/(0.9*0.6) + (3.0*0.4)/(2*1e6*0.47e-6) = 1.31 + 1.28 = 2.6 A < XFL4015-471MEC I_sat 4.4 A and < TPS61023 3.7 A valley limit. Battery-side current ~1.3 A at 3.0 V. Firmware must enable VBUS_BOOST_EN before playback.
qa.source: TI TPS61023 SLVSEU1A sec 9.2.2.2; MAX98357A datasheet efficiency ~85 % at 3 W/4 ohm
